title: The CEO Who Bought a Ghost Town to Dump Toxic Waste
hook: When the town died, the company moved in and started burying secrets in the abandoned homes.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines a haunting location with a chilling corporate crime, triggering outrage and morbid curiosity.

title: The Broker Who Traded on Disguised Voices at Shareholder Meetings
hook: While executives spoke, a hidden trader mimicked their voices to buy insider stock before earnings.
why_this_can_go_viral: Reveals a bizarre, high-tech twist on classic insider trading that feels like a spy thriller.

title: The Startup That Sold 'Invisible' Ink — and Vanished With Investor Millions
hook: They promised a pen that writes with nothing, but the only thing that disappeared was their office.
why_this_can_go_viral: The absurdity of selling 'nothing' as a product creates immediate disbelief and shareability.

why_this_can_go_viral: Explains how a boring industry controls daily life, sparking anger and curiosity about hidden monopolies.

title: The Ad That Used Your Own Voice Against You in an Argument
